Sebastian Kolowa succeeded Stefano Moshi as presiding bishop of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in Tanzania. He was bishop of the North-Eastern (Usambara-Digo) Diocese and took over around 1975–76. Samson Mushemba came after Kolowa, so my earlier answer skipped one person in the succession. I'm working from memory here, not a checked source.

CONFIDENCE: 80
